stem.text: The graph shows the loss of mass in a potted plant due to transpiration.

stem.alt: Line graph of mass/g against time/minutes, with a point labelled X where the line drops steeply after a gradual decline.

stem.text: What could have occurred at point X on the graph?

A.text: A plastic bag was placed around the plant.

B.text: The lower epidermis was sealed with petroleum jelly.

C.text: The plant was placed into a dark cupboard.

D.text: Warm moving air was blown over the plant.
